subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off TUI completion-notification contract now, and if so which modes should be supported first: terminal bell only, macOS desktop notification through existing node/app IPC, or both?
rationale: This is a new user-facing behavior and config surface rather than a broken existing contract, so automation cannot safely choose the notification modes, defaults, platform boundary, or security constraints.

options.title: Design default-off TUI alerts
options.body: Keep this issue open and settle a minimal TUI-owned contract before implementation, preferably terminal bell plus structured macOS notification reuse if available.

options.title: Start with terminal bell only
options.body: Limit core scope to a cross-platform opt-in bell and leave desktop notifications for a later macOS app or node integration decision.

options.title: Defer to broader alerting work
options.body: Route completion alerts into the broader activity/watchdog discussion if maintainers want one shared notification model instead of a TUI-specific option.

recommendation.title: Design default-off TUI alerts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and settle a minimal TUI-owned contract before implementation, preferably terminal bell plus structured macOS notification reuse if available.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-history signal for the TUI status/finalization path and likely product boundary is steipete.
